title: Sonic Flow purchasing and batch planning

places.name: SonaflozinPositionReadings
places.description: External Sonaflozin inventory position (on-hand plus open orders); SAP treatment of quarantine and reading cadence unverified.

places.name: SonaflozinOrdersPlaced
places.description: Sonaflozin order-up-to quantity derived from supplied inventory position; linked to approximate Chinese preparation, transit and quarantine.

places.name: FlowbindPositionReadings
places.description: External Flowbind inventory position (on-hand plus open orders); SAP treatment of quarantine and reading cadence unverified.

places.name: FlowbindOrdersPlaced
places.description: Flowbind top-up order from supplied inventory position; externally assigned to India or Germany, followed by approximate supply timing, pending lot-level release data.

places.name: SupplierPreparing
places.description: Sonaflozin order quantity not yet dispatched; approximately one-week supplier preparation plus conditional outage, followed by possible multiple certified-lot dispatches.

places.name: ChineseSupplyInTransit
places.description: Certified Sonaflozin shipment; both transit time and remaining shelf life count down, customs delay unspecified.

places.name: ChineseSupplyInQuarantine
places.description: Certified Sonaflozin lot in quarantine; both days until release and days until expiry count down; 3-day duration is agent placeholder.

places.name: ChooseIndianFlowbindSupply
places.description: External routing instruction for normal Indian supply; no automatic urgency/outage rule yet.

places.name: ChooseGermanFlowbindSupply
places.description: External routing instruction for urgent top-up or Indian outage; criteria not automated.

places.name: FlowbindIndianOrders
places.description: Flowbind orders assigned to India, followed by approximate preparation/transit/quarantine; lot identity and expiry still unresolved.

places.name: FlowbindGermanOrders
places.description: Small urgent Flowbind top-up orders assigned to Germany; use approximate 15-day recorded lead time without an invented extra priority or queue rule.

places.name: PlannedSonicFlowBatches
places.description: Planned batch units accrue material-wait days until an externally validated FEFO allocation is supplied; split-lot eligibility and lot debits are not enforced internally.

places.name: ForecastBatchReleasesExternal
places.description: Scheduled forecast batch quantity calculated from supplied order-rate snapshot, plan period and average order size; countdown to release. Values also remain directly supplyable for historical replay.

places.name: StaticPlanBatchReleasesExternal
places.description: Externally supplied recorded static-plan batch sizes and days until release, with countdown; plan values not yet provided.

places.name: ForecastSizingInputsExternal
places.description: Externally supplied order-rate snapshot at each batch's planning time, plan period, average order size, and planned release offset; units and planning-to-release lag unverified.

places.name: SonaflozinUsableLots
places.description: Individual quarantine-released certified Sonaflozin lots; remain usable only before fixed expiry; production allocation still missing.

places.name: FlowbindUsableLots
places.description: Individual quarantine-released Flowbind lots with quantity and remaining shelf life supplied by records; India/Germany receipt not yet linked.

places.name: SonaflozinWrittenOffLots
places.description: Sonaflozin lots expired after quarantine release into usable warehouse stock; numerator candidate for provisional warehouse-only expiry rate.

places.name: FlowbindWrittenOffLots
places.description: Expired Flowbind lots removed from production eligibility; write-off quantity preserved.

places.name: SonaflozinCertifiedLotsPreDispatch
places.description: Externally supplied manufacturer's certified lots and expiry remaining; shelf life runs down before dispatch once certificate is issued.

places.name: CustomerOrdersAwaitingFill
places.description: Customer orders with externally supplied promise dates; full-order shipment from agent-assumed aggregate released-goods balance is a draft, not SAP-confirmed.

places.name: CustomerOrdersPastPromise
places.description: Orders not filled by promised date; they may later be filled or cancelled, but those paths are not yet established.

places.name: SonaflozinExpiredInTransit
places.description: Expired certified Sonaflozin lots lost during transit; separately reported, outside provisional warehouse expiry rate.

places.name: SonaflozinExpiredBeforeRelease
places.description: Lots expired after certificate issuance but before usable release (before dispatch or in quarantine); distinct from transit and warehouse expiry.

places.name: FlowbindSupplierPreparing
places.description: Indian or German Flowbind order in approximate seven-day supplier preparation; no separate urgency queue or priority mechanism beyond source choice and reported lead time.

places.name: FlowbindSupplyInTransit
places.description: Flowbind order from India or Germany in approximate source-specific transit; expiry not tracked before lot data provided.

places.name: FlowbindSupplyInQuarantine
places.description: India or Germany Flowbind supply undergoing few-day quarantine represented with agent three-day placeholder; lot expiry not yet linked.

places.name: FlowbindReleasedQuantityNeedsLotData
places.description: Flowbind quantity after supplier prep, transit and quarantine; cannot become usable lot stock until lot IDs, dates and released quantities are supplied.

places.name: CompletedSonicFlowBatchesExternal
places.description: Completed Sonic Flow batches produced by approximate one-week production path, or externally supplied for replay; FEFO allocation prior to run is external stand-in.

places.name: FinishedGoodsInQuarantine
places.description: Finished Sonic Flow awaiting batch-matched quality clearance; elapsed days recorded, no inferred exact hold or automatic release.

places.name: FinishedGoodsQualityClearancesExternal
places.description: Externally supplied batch-matched positive quality release; timing and negative outcomes await quality records.

places.name: FinishedGoodsReleasedForShipping
places.description: Quality-released finished Sonic Flow batch awaiting transfer to an agent-assumed aggregate shippable balance for full-order shipment.

places.name: FEFOAllocationsExternal
places.description: Agent stand-in: external allocator certifies one batch can consume its full units of each material from eligible released lots in FEFO order; neither computation nor lot debit is enforced here.

places.name: SonicFlowInProduction
places.description: Started batch running roughly seven days after external FEFO allocation; no plant-capacity constraint established.

places.name: StartedBatchWaitHistory
places.description: Records batch size and scheduled-to-actual-start wait for unit-weighted production-delay reporting.

places.name: ReleasedFinishedGoodsBalance
places.description: Agent aggregate approximation for shippable Sonic Flow units; needs one dated opening balance token from the same SAP snapshot in both cases.

places.name: CustomerOrdersShippedOnTime
places.description: Customer orders wholly shipped no later than promised date; immediate shipment event approximation, no transit.

places.name: CustomerOrdersShippedLate
places.description: Customer orders wholly shipped after promised date; partials and cancellations still unspecified.

transitions.name: Place Sonaflozin order
transitions.description: Place top-up order in Sonaflozin units when externally supplied inventory position is strictly below 2,500; SAP quarantine inclusion unverified.
transitions.transitionKernelCode: return { SonaflozinOrdersPlaced: [{ quantity: parameters.son_order_up_to - input.SonaflozinPositionReadings[0].inventory_position }] };

transitions.name: Place Flowbind order
transitions.description: Place top-up order in Flowbind units when externally supplied inventory position is strictly below 1,500; SAP quarantine inclusion unverified.
transitions.transitionKernelCode: return { FlowbindOrdersPlaced: [{ quantity: parameters.flow_order_up_to - input.FlowbindPositionReadings[0].inventory_position }] };

transitions.name: Start Chinese supplier preparation
transitions.description: Placed Sonaflozin order begins Chinese supplier preparation; approximate one-week preparation plus scenario outage delay.
transitions.transitionKernelCode: const order = input.SonaflozinOrdersPlaced[0]; return { SupplierPreparing: [{ quantity: order.quantity, days_remaining: parameters.supplier_prep_days + parameters.outage_delay_days }] };

transitions.name: Dispatch certified Sonaflozin lot against order balance
transitions.description: After preparation, dispatch a certified lot no larger than remaining order quantity, retaining unshipped balance for further lots; lot-to-order identity matching not yet implemented.
transitions.lambdaCode: const order = input.SupplierPreparing[0]; const lot = input.SonaflozinCertifiedLotsPreDispatch[0]; return order.days_remaining <= 0 && order.quantity > 0 && lot.quantity > 0 && lot.days_until_expiry > 0 && lot.quantity <= order.quantity;
transitions.transitionKernelCode: const order = input.SupplierPreparing[0]; const lot = input.SonaflozinCertifiedLotsPreDispatch[0]; return { ChineseSupplyInTransit: [{ lot_ref: lot.lot_ref, quantity: lot.quantity, days_remaining: parameters.transit_days, days_until_expiry: lot.days_until_expiry }], SupplierPreparing: [{ quantity: order.quantity - lot.quantity, days_remaining: order.days_remaining }] };

transitions.name: Arrive and enter quarantine
transitions.description: On completed transit, pass certified lot into quarantine with its remaining shelf life; customs delay still unspecified.
transitions.transitionKernelCode: const lot = input.ChineseSupplyInTransit[0]; return { ChineseSupplyInQuarantine: [{ lot_ref: lot.lot_ref, quantity: lot.quantity, days_remaining: parameters.quarantine_days_placeholder, days_until_expiry: lot.days_until_expiry }] };

transitions.name: Release Chinese supplier material
transitions.description: After quarantine, release only still-unexpired certified Sonaflozin lot to usable lot inventory; quarantine duration remains an agent placeholder.
transitions.lambdaCode: const lot = input.ChineseSupplyInQuarantine[0]; return lot.days_remaining <= 0 && lot.days_until_expiry > 0;
transitions.transitionKernelCode: const lot = input.ChineseSupplyInQuarantine[0]; return { SonaflozinUsableLots: [{ lot_ref: lot.lot_ref, quantity: lot.quantity, days_until_expiry: lot.days_until_expiry }] };

transitions.name: Assign Flowbind order to India
transitions.description: Explicit external choice for normal Indian source; routing criteria not yet represented automatically.
transitions.transitionKernelCode: return { FlowbindIndianOrders: [{ quantity: input.FlowbindOrdersPlaced[0].quantity }] };

transitions.name: Assign Flowbind order to Germany
transitions.description: Explicit external choice for urgent top-up or India outage; urgency and outage selection criteria unestablished.
transitions.transitionKernelCode: return { FlowbindGermanOrders: [{ quantity: input.FlowbindOrdersPlaced[0].quantity }] };

transitions.name: Release live-forecast batch
transitions.description: Release externally scheduled live-forecast batch when due and forecast policy is selected.
transitions.transitionKernelCode: return { PlannedSonicFlowBatches: [{ quantity: input.ForecastBatchReleasesExternal[0].quantity, wait_days: 0 }] };

transitions.name: Release recorded static-plan batch
transitions.description: Release externally scheduled recorded static-plan batch when due and static plan selected.
transitions.transitionKernelCode: return { PlannedSonicFlowBatches: [{ quantity: input.StaticPlanBatchReleasesExternal[0].quantity, wait_days: 0 }] };

transitions.name: Calculate batch from live forecast inputs
transitions.description: Multiply externally supplied current order rate, plan period and average order size; preserve specified release offset. Input units, timing and rounding unverified.
transitions.transitionKernelCode: const f = input.ForecastSizingInputsExternal[0]; return { ForecastBatchReleasesExternal: [{ quantity: f.order_rate * f.plan_period * f.average_order_size, days_until_release: f.days_until_release }] };

transitions.name: Write off expired Sonaflozin lot
transitions.description: Remove lot when its remaining shelf life reaches zero; remains available for neither production nor stock totals.
transitions.transitionKernelCode: const lot = input.SonaflozinUsableLots[0]; return { SonaflozinWrittenOffLots: [{ lot_ref: lot.lot_ref, quantity: lot.quantity, days_until_expiry: lot.days_until_expiry }] };

transitions.name: Write off expired Flowbind lot
transitions.description: Remove expired Flowbind lot and preserve written-off quantity.
transitions.transitionKernelCode: const lot = input.FlowbindUsableLots[0]; return { FlowbindWrittenOffLots: [{ lot_ref: lot.lot_ref, quantity: lot.quantity, days_until_expiry: lot.days_until_expiry }] };

transitions.name: Record Sonaflozin expiry before dispatch
transitions.description: Keep lot expiry before dispatch separate from warehouse expiry; replacement/financial fate of order unconfirmed.
transitions.transitionKernelCode: const lot = input.SonaflozinCertifiedLotsPreDispatch[0]; return { SonaflozinExpiredBeforeRelease: [{ lot_ref: lot.lot_ref, quantity: lot.quantity, days_until_expiry: lot.days_until_expiry }] };

transitions.name: Record Sonaflozin lot expired in transit
transitions.description: Keep in-transit lot expiry separate from provisional warehouse expiry target; financial ownership remains unknown.
transitions.transitionKernelCode: const lot = input.ChineseSupplyInTransit[0]; return { SonaflozinExpiredInTransit: [{ lot_ref: lot.lot_ref, quantity: lot.quantity, days_until_expiry: lot.days_until_expiry }] };

transitions.name: Record Sonaflozin expiry before release
transitions.description: Quarantined lot expiry retained separately from warehouse-use expiry; treatment in team's rate unverified.
transitions.transitionKernelCode: const lot = input.ChineseSupplyInQuarantine[0]; return { SonaflozinExpiredBeforeRelease: [{ lot_ref: lot.lot_ref, quantity: lot.quantity, days_until_expiry: lot.days_until_expiry }] };

transitions.name: Close fully dispatched Sonaflozin order
transitions.description: Clear zero remaining order balance after all certified lots have dispatched; no order-level completion history retained.

transitions.name: Start Indian Flowbind preparation
transitions.description: Approximate seven days supplier preparation; Indian order quantity becomes an un-lotted supply stage.
transitions.transitionKernelCode: return { FlowbindSupplierPreparing: [{ quantity: input.FlowbindIndianOrders[0].quantity, supplier_code: 0, days_remaining: parameters.flow_prep_days_approx }] };

transitions.name: Start German Flowbind preparation
transitions.description: German Flowbind urgent top-up enters approximate seven-day supplier preparation; recorded total lead time is about 15 days, with no extra priority mechanism.
transitions.transitionKernelCode: return { FlowbindSupplierPreparing: [{ quantity: input.FlowbindGermanOrders[0].quantity, supplier_code: 1, days_remaining: parameters.flow_prep_days_approx }] };

transitions.name: Dispatch Flowbind supply
transitions.description: After approximate seven-day preparation, source-specific transit lasts about seven days India or eight Germany; no priority queue or expiry yet.
transitions.transitionKernelCode: const order = input.FlowbindSupplierPreparing[0]; return { FlowbindSupplyInTransit: [{ quantity: order.quantity, supplier_code: order.supplier_code, days_remaining: order.supplier_code === 0 ? parameters.flow_india_transit_days_approx : parameters.flow_germany_transit_days_approx }] };

transitions.name: Receive Flowbind into quarantine
transitions.description: After source-specific transit, Flowbind enters a few-day quarantine using an agent three-day placeholder.
transitions.transitionKernelCode: const order = input.FlowbindSupplyInTransit[0]; return { FlowbindSupplyInQuarantine: [{ quantity: order.quantity, supplier_code: order.supplier_code, days_remaining: parameters.flow_quarantine_days_placeholder }] };

transitions.name: Finish Flowbind quarantine pending lot records
transitions.description: After few-day placeholder quarantine, carry supplier source and quantity to boundary requiring individual lot IDs, expiry and release records before usable stock.
transitions.transitionKernelCode: const order = input.FlowbindSupplyInQuarantine[0]; return { FlowbindReleasedQuantityNeedsLotData: [{ quantity: order.quantity, supplier_code: order.supplier_code, days_remaining: 0 }] };

transitions.name: Place completed Sonic Flow in finished-goods quarantine
transitions.description: External completed batch enters finished-goods quarantine; stand-in until material-compliant production completion is connected.
transitions.transitionKernelCode: const batch = input.CompletedSonicFlowBatchesExternal[0]; return { FinishedGoodsInQuarantine: [{ batch_ref: batch.batch_ref, quantity: batch.quantity, days_in_quarantine: 0 }] };

transitions.name: Release cleared finished goods for shipping
transitions.description: Only a matching externally supplied positive quality clearance can release a batch; no automatic release on an inferred hold time, no rejection path yet.
transitions.transitionKernelCode: const batch = input.FinishedGoodsInQuarantine[0]; return { FinishedGoodsReleasedForShipping: [{ batch_ref: batch.batch_ref, quantity: batch.quantity, days_in_quarantine: batch.days_in_quarantine }] };

transitions.name: Start batch after externally checked FEFO allocation
transitions.description: Assumed external allocation covers every unit of both materials from released, eligible FEFO lots; net checks quantities but not lot-level FEFO or stock debit, so cannot independently establish material feasibility.
transitions.lambdaCode: const b = input.PlannedSonicFlowBatches[0]; const a = input.FEFOAllocationsExternal[0]; return b.quantity > 0 && a.quantity === b.quantity && a.son_qty === b.quantity && a.flow_qty === b.quantity;
transitions.transitionKernelCode: const b = input.PlannedSonicFlowBatches[0]; const a = input.FEFOAllocationsExternal[0]; return { SonicFlowInProduction: [{ batch_ref: a.batch_ref, quantity: b.quantity, days_remaining: parameters.production_days_approx, wait_days: b.wait_days }], StartedBatchWaitHistory: [{ quantity: b.quantity, wait_days: b.wait_days }] };

transitions.name: Complete roughly one-week Sonic Flow production
transitions.description: Running batch completes at days remaining zero and enters finished-goods quarantine path; duration approximate and capacity unspecified.
transitions.transitionKernelCode: const run = input.SonicFlowInProduction[0]; return { CompletedSonicFlowBatchesExternal: [{ batch_ref: run.batch_ref, quantity: run.quantity, days_in_quarantine: 0 }] };

transitions.name: Add quality-released batch to shippable balance
transitions.description: Aggregate approximation; requires an initial balance token from shared SAP snapshot, and retains no batch identity once pooled.
transitions.transitionKernelCode: const b = input.ReleasedFinishedGoodsBalance[0]; const g = input.FinishedGoodsReleasedForShipping[0]; return { ReleasedFinishedGoodsBalance: [{ quantity: b.quantity + g.quantity }] };

transitions.name: Mark unfilled customer order past promise
transitions.description: If a customer order remains unfilled after its promised date, keep it available for late shipping; exact day-boundary convention assumed.
transitions.transitionKernelCode: const o = input.CustomerOrdersAwaitingFill[0]; return { CustomerOrdersPastPromise: [{ order_ref: o.order_ref, quantity: o.quantity, days_to_promise: o.days_to_promise }] };

transitions.name: Ship whole customer order on or before promise
transitions.description: Assumed immediate shipment from aggregate quality-released goods; no delivery transit, allocation priority or partials; quantity fully deducted.
transitions.lambdaCode: const o = input.CustomerOrdersAwaitingFill[0]; const s = input.ReleasedFinishedGoodsBalance[0]; return o.quantity > 0 && o.days_to_promise >= 0 && s.quantity >= o.quantity;
transitions.transitionKernelCode: const o = input.CustomerOrdersAwaitingFill[0]; const s = input.ReleasedFinishedGoodsBalance[0]; return { CustomerOrdersShippedOnTime: [{ order_ref: o.order_ref, quantity: o.quantity, days_to_promise: o.days_to_promise }], ReleasedFinishedGoodsBalance: [{ quantity: s.quantity - o.quantity }] };

transitions.name: Ship whole customer order after promise
transitions.description: Assumed immediate full-order shipment from aggregate released goods after promised date, no transit or explicit allocation priority.
transitions.lambdaCode: const o = input.CustomerOrdersPastPromise[0]; const s = input.ReleasedFinishedGoodsBalance[0]; return o.quantity > 0 && s.quantity >= o.quantity;
transitions.transitionKernelCode: const o = input.CustomerOrdersPastPromise[0]; const s = input.ReleasedFinishedGoodsBalance[0]; return { CustomerOrdersShippedLate: [{ order_ref: o.order_ref, quantity: o.quantity, days_to_promise: o.days_to_promise }], ReleasedFinishedGoodsBalance: [{ quantity: s.quantity - o.quantity }] };

types.name: Inventory position observation
types.description: External reading in material units; Elena describes on-hand plus open orders, but SAP quarantine inclusion is unverified.

types.name: Purchase order amount
types.description: Material-order and aggregate balance quantity in the relevant material's units; batch quantity is Sonic Flow units under one-to-one recipe.

types.name: Sonaflozin order balance awaiting dispatch
types.description: Outstanding Sonaflozin order units and time until initial dispatch eligibility; after the first lot, remaining order units await more certified lots.

types.name: Scheduled Sonic Flow batch
types.description: Externally specified batch size and days until release; dates and sizes to come from forecast or recorded static plan.

types.name: Forecast sizing snapshot
types.description: Order rate at each batch's planning time, plan period and average order size, with planned release offset; units and timing unverified.

types.name: Material lot with expiry
types.description: One material lot with external lot reference, remaining material units and days to expiry.

types.name: Certified Sonaflozin shipment lot
types.description: One dispatched certified lot: lot reference, quantity, days until stage completion and days until fixed expiry date.

types.name: Customer order promise
types.description: One externally supplied customer order with reference, requested Sonic Flow units and days remaining to promised fulfillment.

types.name: Planned production batch and material wait
types.description: Planned Sonic Flow units and elapsed days since scheduled start; delay stops at a future material-eligible actual start.

types.name: Flowbind supplier stage
types.description: Flowbind quantity, source code 0 India/1 Germany, and days until the current preparation, transit or quarantine stage ends; no lot identity or expiry yet.

types.name: Finished Sonic Flow batch
types.description: Finished Sonic Flow batch carrying batch reference, quantity and days in finished-goods quarantine; fed by draft production completion or external replay.

types.name: Finished-goods quality clearance
types.description: Externally supplied positive quality release for a specified Sonic Flow batch; no release timing or rejection process inferred.

types.name: Externally checked batch material allocation
types.description: Agent stand-in: externally supplied per-batch confirmation of FEFO allocation and quantities of both released eligible materials; the net does not itself calculate or debit lots.

types.name: Sonic Flow batch in production
types.description: Batch quantity, reference, running days remaining and prior material wait; derived only from externally certified allocation.

types.name: Actual production start and prior wait
types.description: One started batch's unit quantity and material-wait days, for a candidate unit-weighted scheduled-to-start metric.

types.name: Aggregate released finished-goods stock
types.description: Agent approximation: one aggregate stock balance, not physical lots; initialized only with a verified starting position.

differentialEquations.name: Supply stage time remaining in days
Days until scheduled production batch release
Lot shelf life remaining in days
Transit or quarantine and shelf life countdown

parameters.name: Outage at order trigger days (scenario input)
Quarantine days (agent placeholder, replace from records)
Use static production plan rather than live forecast
Flowbind German transit days (approximate, inferred split)

scenarios.name: Live forecast during two-week China outage
scenarios.description: Forecast-driven production and 14-day China pre-dispatch outage. Both alternatives need the same most recent clean dated SAP snapshot: reject a candidate amid migration, inconsistent entries or an incompletely propagated correction; verify stock and open-order reliability. Date and snapshot data pending, not zero.

scenarios.name: Static plan during two-week China outage
scenarios.description: Static dated production plan and 14-day China pre-dispatch outage. Both alternatives need the same most recent clean dated SAP snapshot: reject a candidate amid migration, inconsistent entries or an incompletely propagated correction; verify stock and open-order reliability. Date and snapshot data pending, not zero.

metrics.name: Sonaflozin units expired after usable release
metrics.description: Cumulative Sonaflozin quantity expired after quarantine release into usable stock; numerator candidate for Elena's provisional warehouse expiry definition, not an expiry rate.

metrics.name: Flowbind units written off
metrics.description: Cumulative expired Flowbind units from usable lots; excludes expiry before release or in transit.

metrics.name: Sonaflozin units expired in transit
metrics.description: Cumulative certified Sonaflozin quantity expiring in transit, reported separately from provisional warehouse expiry numerator.

metrics.name: Sonaflozin units expired before usable release
metrics.description: Cumulative Sonaflozin expiry before dispatch or in quarantine; kept apart from transit and warehouse expiry pending team's exact target definition.

metrics.name: Candidate fraction of orders wholly shipped by promise
metrics.description: Reporting-only draft: on-time count divided by on-time, late and past-promise open counts; horizon eligibility and orders not yet due require verification; zero denominator returns 0.
metrics.code: const on = state.places.CustomerOrdersShippedOnTime.count; const late = state.places.CustomerOrdersShippedLate.count; const overdue = state.places.CustomerOrdersPastPromise.count; const total = on + late + overdue; return total === 0 ? 0 : on / total;

metrics.name: Candidate unit-weighted batch-start wait (weeks)
metrics.description: Draft average of recorded scheduled-to-actual-start wait weighted by started batch size; excludes unstarted batches and uses seven days per week.
metrics.code: const r = state.places.StartedBatchWaitHistory.tokens; const units = r.reduce((sum, b) => sum + b.quantity, 0); return units <= 0 ? 0 : r.reduce((sum, b) => sum + b.quantity * b.wait_days, 0) / units / 7;
